map.用地分类代码 R/A/B/M/S/U/G 分别代表什么？: What do the land use codes R/A/B/M/S/U/G stand for?
map.R 居住用地、A 公共管理与公共服务、B 商业服务业设施、M 工业、S 道路与交: R residential land, A public administration and public services, B commercial and service facilities, M industrial, S road and traffic facilities, U utilities, G green space and squares. These are the level-1 category codes of "Standard for Classification of Urban Land Use and Planning Construction Land" GB 50137.
map.人均建设用地标准的意义？: What is the significance of the per-capita construction land standard?
